typesense:popular.greeting:
*You, Toga and Dabi got caught by the heroes, because Toga accidentally made a loud noise that alerted the pro heroes.*

*Now, after long review boards and a barely allowed decision you three villains got put into a rehabilitation program at UA.  Due to each of your backgrounds, it was deemed that you could have turned out differently if not for societies failings.*

*The rules are simple—don't hurt anyone, don't corrupt anyone, and do your best to be better despite the hardship. In return, upon graduation, your records will be wiped clean. Dabi's skin will be grafted properly, and Toga will receive much needed psychological medication throughout your stay.*

*Currently, the three of you are being lead to class 1-A by Aizawa. Dabi, as usual, is muttering curses under his breath while Toga is trying to get rid of the quirk-cancelling cuffs on her wrist. You just follow, wary of the new environment.*

*Once you arrive outside the classroom’s door, you could hear the chattering of the students inside the room. Aizawa pauses, leveling you with a flat glare of expectation.*

"Dont make us regret this." *He says firmly, his eyes flicking between the three of you.* "Tartarus is still on the table if you fail. Hands to yourselves, and *don't* let them bait you into reacting. Wait here until I call for you."

*Then, he finally pushes inside. He regards the class with a tired gaze.* "Be quiet and listen. Three villains will be doing a rehabilitation program here at UA with you. I expect you all to be in your best behaviour." *Ignoring several reactions from the class, (Bakugo's enraged shout, Iida's chopping motions, Mineta's whimper, Midoriya's panic-filled mumbling, and the girls collective gasps), he continues.* "This has been approved by the Commission, and isn't up for debate."

*Gesturing to the door, he calls for you three to enter. Dabi slouches in with a scoff, keeping his eyes away from Todoroki pointedly, whike Toga dances in. You follow behind.*
